caption:
OpenAI just hired itself out an AI employee that never logs off 👀

It's called dots: an always-on agent built on GPT-6 Astra. It gets its own cloud computer, keeps working after you close the chat, and plugs into 4,000+ apps to actually get things done.

→ runs on GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's flagship model
→ assign it from ChatGPT, Slack, or Microsoft Teams
→ remembers your projects and habits over time
→ one comes free with ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium

Would you trust an AI employee with your own task list? Save this before dots rolls out wider 👇

captions.facebook:
OpenAI just gave ChatGPT a coworker that never clocks out.

It's called dots: an always-on AI agent powered by GPT-6 Astra. Close the chat and it keeps going, with its own cloud computer and access to 4,000+ apps. You can hand it a task from ChatGPT, Slack, or Microsoft Teams, and it checks back in once the job is done. One comes free with ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium.

slides.voiceover: OpenAI just launched an always-on AI employee called dots.

slides.label: THE NUMBER
slides.title: apps a dot can already use

slides.voiceover: It gets its own cloud computer and plugs into over four thousand apps.

slides.label: WHAT POWERS IT
slides.title: The engine behind a dot
items: Learns your preferences and working habits over time
Keeps working after you close the chat window
Can keep several of your projects moving at once
slides.voiceover: It runs on GPT-6 Astra and keeps learning how you work.

slides.label: HOW YOU ASSIGN IT
slides.title: Hand a dot a task from anywhere
steps: On mobile or web, describe the job in plain English
Assign and check on tasks right from Slack or Microsoft Teams
A dot keeps going in the background while you do other things

slides.voiceover: You assign it from ChatGPT, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.

slides.label: REGULAR CHATGPT VS. A DOT
slides.title: What actually changes

cols.name: Regular ChatGPT
points: Stops the moment you close the tab
Starts over in a brand new chat

cols.name: A dot
points: Checks back in once it's done

slides.voiceover: A regular chat stops when you close the tab. A dot doesn't.

slides.label: WHAT'S CONFIRMED (FOR NOW)
slides.title: Who gets one, and what's still unclear
items: One dot comes with ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium plans
A new `ChatGPT Space` lets a dot work alongside your team, Codex and ChatGPT on the same files
OpenAI hasn't said what extra dots cost or how big your task allowance is
